arguments.message:
S1968 interim finding (verified by compiling probe tmp/sheaf/xif/paper/_S1968Probe2.lean EXIT=0 and _S1968Probe1.lean sections 1-5):

1) The reduced R6 anchor strip's value monoid is DEGENERATE: reducedQPilotAnchor D = fPrimeStripAt 1 0 = S1487Strip 1 0, and S1487Strip.Mon v = SourceHaarActualValueMonoid = Multiplicative {x : Real // x <= 0} for every v. Its unit group is TRIVIAL (if x <= 0 and -x <= 0 then x = 0), so
   Subsingleton ((reducedQPilotAnchor D).Mon v)^  (proved)
   Subsingleton ((reducedQPilotTimesMu D).timesMu v) (proved)
   => the whole times-mu / O^{x-mu} layer of the reduced anchor is trivial in this model.
   Consequence for S1967 (OUnitsMu): OUnits D v = ((lgpStrip D).Mon v)^ is a SUBSINGLETON, and OUnitsMu D v = TimesMuQuotient (OUnits D v) is a subsingleton too. Any S1967 construction of nontrivial x-mu data on this strip is vacuous unless the strip/value monoid is changed. Please check before further S1967 work.
   Consequence for R6: for ANY paper strip P, Nonempty (QPilotAnchorIdentification D P) forces Subsingleton (P.timesMu v) for all v (proved). So in the current reduced model R6 can only be closed by a paper strip whose x-mu fibers are trivial — i.e. one that cannot carry q_v-dependent O^{x-mu} data.

2) R6 proper still missing; q_v data are real scalars: (paperInput D).initial.reduction.qParameter b = (1/5)^order_C3 (S1527), |log q_b| = order_C3 * log 5 = localLogMagnitude S1487Cand. The only SourceFTimesMuPrimeStrip constructor in the tree is SourceFTimesMuPrimeStrip.canonical; the only F-prime-strips available are the shear strips I.fPrimeStripAt n m = S1487Strip n m, which are definitionally independent of the initial theta data (hence of q_v). So no existing strip can be certified as the paper q-pilot strip.

3) I am building the actual paper-side q-pilot OBJECT (not strip) from the actual q_v: the order-weighted arithmetic divisor in S1927's global realified Frobenioid C^boxplus_mod, with deg = sum |log q_b| (so q-pilot log-volume = -|log q|), plus the exact first-missing statement and the R6 reduction. Will report SHA/EXIT/olean when S1968QVDeterminedQPilotActual.lean is green.
